title: Mailchimp Marketing API key: one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: literal marker: the -us14 data-center suffix is removed, leaving the 32-hex body (basis: provider) and literal marker: the -us14 data-center suffix separator becomes _us14 (the -<dc> suffix is provider-stated) (basis: provider). Twin of "Mailchimp Marketing API key: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
